strategies.name: Trendilo ALMA-50 % change over / under its RMS band, out through zero, 2 ATR (dudeowns)
strategies.rules: Trendilo (dudeowns, open source): ALMA 50 of the bar % change against its RMS band - over the band = up trend, under minus the band = down trend. Ours: enter when the trend turns +1 / -1, out when the smoothed change crosses zero against the trade; stop 2 ATR, no fixed target.

strategies.name: Darvas box breakout / breakdown, stop past the box, 2R
strategies.source: Darvas box (Darvas 1960; TradingView Advanced Intraday Darvas Box)
strategies.rules: Nicolas Darvas' box (1960): top = a 20-bar high not exceeded for 3 bars, bottom = the lowest low after it not broken for 3 bars; buy the close over the top of a complete box, stop 0.1 ATR under the box bottom (Darvas' stop), target 2R (ours - Darvas trailed into the next box). Breakdown under the bottom = the short mirror (ours).

strategies.name: VSA no-supply (no-demand) test in the trend, close past its high (low) within 2 bars, 2R
strategies.source: VSA no supply / no demand (Tom Williams; TradingView NSND open source)
strategies.rules: VSA (Tom Williams, 'Master the Markets'): a no-supply bar (down bar, below-average true-range spread, volume under the two previous bars) inside an up trend = professionals not selling; buy when a following bar (within 2) closes over its high. Stop 0.1 ATR under the no-supply bar, 2R. Mirror: no-demand bar in a down trend. Trend = close over a rising EMA50 (ours). Tick volume.

strategies.name: VSA upthrust / spring on high volume, next close past its low (high), bar stop, 2R
strategies.rules: VSA upthrust / spring: a new 20-bar high on high volume (> 1.5 x average) that closes back under the broken high = upthrust; sell when the next bar closes under the upthrust bar's low, stop 0.1 ATR over its high, 2R. Spring (shakeout) = mirror for longs.

strategies.name: Round '00' level rejection (unbroken 20 bars, wick >= body), stop 0.5 ATR past the level, 2R
strategies.rules: Psychological round levels (BabyPips / DailyFX 'psychological levels and round numbers'): a touch of a '00' level that no close has gone through in the last 20 bars, rejected - low within 0.05 ATR of the level under the previous close, close back over it, a bullish rejection candle (lower wick >= the body and >= 30% of the range); stop 0.5 ATR under the level (or 0.1 ATR under the low if lower), 2R. Mirror at the level over. OUR translation of '00' to every instrument: step = 10^(digits - 2) of the price (EURUSD 0.01, USDJPY 1, gold 10, US100 100).

strategies.name: Round '00' level break and retest in 3-20 bars, stop 0.5 ATR past the level, 2R
strategies.rules: Round level break and retest (BabyPips psychological levels; IG 'Psychological Levels & Round Numbers'): a close through a '00' level, then within 3-20 bars a pull back that touches it (0.1 ATR) and closes away in the break's direction; stop 0.5 ATR beyond the level, 2R. Same level step as SC420.

strategies.name: ADR exhaustion fade: >= 100% of ADR14 used, day-extreme reversal close, target the day mid, flat 21 UTC
strategies.source: How to use the Average Daily Range (FXStreet)
strategies.rules: ADR exhaustion fade (FXStreet 'How to use the Average Daily Range'; forex-station / MQL5 ADR fade): once the day has used >= 100% of its 14-day ADR, a bar that makes the day's extreme and then a reversal close (back under the previous bar's low for a short) fades toward the day's middle. Stop 0.2 ATR beyond the day extreme, target the running day mid; flat at 21:00 UTC (the forex day end). Intraday, UTC days.

strategies.name: NY 15-min ORB only while < 60% of ADR14 is used, range stop, 2R, flat 16:00 NY
strategies.source: ADR room rule (NexusFi ADR; FXStreet) on the NY 15-min ORB
strategies.rules: New York 15-minute opening range (09:30-09:45) breakout only while the day has used < 60% of its ADR at the break (the ADR 'room left' rule of FXStreet / NexusFi ADR guides): close through the range, stop at the other side, 2R, flat 16:00 NY, first break per day. Differs from SS01 by the ADR filter.

strategies.name: ICT CBDR: 20-11 NY rejection of CBDR +/- 2 SD, stop past 3 SD, target the CBDR edge, flat 16:00
strategies.source: ICT Central Bank Dealers Range (CBDR Deviations, TradingView open source)
strategies.rules: ICT Central Bank Dealers Range (Mentorship month 8; 'CBDR Deviations' open source): the 14:00-20:00 NY range projects the next day's extremes at 1-4 standard deviations (one SD = the range's height). Ours: from 20:00 NY (Asia) to 11:00 NY (London / NY morning), a bar that trades through CBDR high + 2 SD and closes back under it = short, stop 0.1 ATR over the 3 SD level or the bar high (the higher), target the CBDR high; mirror under CBDR low - 2 SD. Flat 16:00 NY.

strategies.name: Street Smarts Whiplash (NY cash sessions): gap past the prior extreme, close in the other half, next session, 2R
strategies.source: Street Smarts Whiplash (Raschke & Connors; cryptodatadownload port)
strategies.rules: Whiplash (Raschke & Connors, 'Street Smarts' 1995, a daily S&P pattern; cryptodatadownload.com port): the session opens with a gap under the previous session's low and closes in the top half of its range (over its open) = buy the next session's open, sell at that session's close (as published); mirror for a gap over the previous high that closes in the lower half. Ours: sessions = New York cash hours 09:30-16:00 on intraday bars (the signal sits on the bar before the next 09:30 open, so the entry is that open), stop 0.1 ATR beyond the signal session's extreme, target 2R, flat 16:00 NY.

strategies.name: Street Smarts Turtle Soup Plus One: close at a new 20-bar low, next close back over the old low, 2R
strategies.source: Turtle Soup Plus One (Street Smarts; TradingView idea)
strategies.rules: Turtle Soup Plus One (Raschke & Connors, 'Street Smarts'): the previous bar CLOSED at a new 20-bar low, the prior 20-bar low having been set at least 3 bars before; this bar closes back over that earlier 20-bar low = buy; stop 0.1 ATR under the lower of the two bars' lows, target 2R (the book: trail, partial at 1-2 days). Mirror for the high. Differs from SS13 (Turtle Soup: same-bar re-entry, no close beyond required).

strategies.name: Joe Ross 1-2-3 reversal: close through point 2, stop under point 3, 2R
strategies.rules: Joe Ross 1-2-3 reversal (tradingeducators.com; LuxAlgo '1-2-3 Reversal'): point 1 = a 30-bar swing low, 2 = the swing high after it, 3 = a higher swing low (all confirmed, k 3); buy on the close through point 2, stop 0.1 ATR under point 3, target 2R. Mirror for tops.

strategies.name: Joe Ross hook after the 1-2-3 break: close through the hook, stop under the pullback, 2R
strategies.rules: Ross hook (Joe Ross; FXOpen 'How to Trade with a Ross Hook Pattern'): after the 1-2-3 break, the first bar that fails to make a new high forms the hook; buy on the close through the hook high, stop 0.1 ATR under the lowest low since the hook, target 2R. Mirror.

strategies.name: Three Line Break reversal on the EMA50 side, out on the opposite reversal, 2 ATR (Nison)
strategies.source: Three Line Break Backtest (TradingView open source; Nison)
strategies.rules: Three Line Break (Steve Nison, 'Beyond Candlesticks'; TradingView 'Three Line Break Backtest' open source): trade the reversal - a close beyond the extreme of the last 3 lines - in the EMA50's direction, out on the opposite reversal; stop 2 ATR, no fixed target.

strategies.name: Point & Figure double-top buy / double-bottom sell, 3-box reversal, box 0.5 ATR50, column stop, 2R
strategies.source: Point & Figure double top / bottom (LuxAlgo concept)
strategies.rules: Point & Figure double-top buy / double-bottom sell (3-box reversal on closes, box 0.5 x ATR50 fixed when a column starts - our translation of a fixed box; LuxAlgo 'Point & Figure', StockCharts P&F): buy when an X column rises over the previous X column's top, stop 0.1 ATR under the current column's bottom (the column start), target 2R. Mirror.

strategies.name: Ehlers Ultimate Oscillator 2025 zero cross, out on the cross back, 2 ATR (TASC 2025.04)
strategies.source: Ehlers 'The Ultimate Oscillator', TASC 2025.04 Traders' Tips
strategies.rules: Ehlers 'The Ultimate Oscillator' (TASC 2025.04; Wealth-Lab rule in the Traders' Tips): buy when the UO crosses over zero, exit when it crosses back under; mirror for shorts (ours). Stop 2 ATR, no fixed target.

strategies.name: Ehlers UltimateSmoother 40 cross of the Laguerre filter 0.8, cross-back exit, 2 ATR (TASC 2025.07)
strategies.rules: Ehlers 'Laguerre Filters' (TASC 2025.07; Wealth-Lab rule): long when the UltimateSmoother(40) crosses over the Laguerre filter (gamma 0.8), exit when it crosses under; mirror for shorts (ours). Stop 2 ATR.

strategies.name: Ehlers Laguerre oscillator turn from beyond -2 / +2 SD, 3% stop, filter-cross exit (TASC 2025.07)
strategies.rules: Ehlers Laguerre oscillator (TASC 2025.07; Wealth-Lab rule): buy when the RMS-normalised oscillator turns up from under -2 (Wealth-Lab: between -2 and -3 SD), 3% stop as published, exit when the UltimateSmoother crosses under the Laguerre filter. Mirror (turn down from over +2) for shorts - ours.

strategies.name: Ehlers Continuation Index through +/-0.5, out through 0, 2 ATR (TASC 2025.09)
strategies.rules: Ehlers 'The Continuation Index' (TASC 2025.09): CI over +0.5 = a strong trend that should continue. The article gives no trade rule - ours: buy when CI crosses over +0.5, out when it falls under 0; mirror under -0.5. Stop 2 ATR, no fixed target.

strategies.name: Ehlers One Euro oscillator zero cross with the filter slope, 2 ATR, 2R (TASC 2025.12)
strategies.rules: Ehlers 'The One Euro Filter' (TASC 2025.12): the oscillator (filter of HP54) crossing zero while the One Euro filter of the close slopes the same way. No rule in the article - ours: 2 ATR stop, 2R target.

strategies.name: Ehlers projected MA 20 turns up / down, out on the opposite turn, 2 ATR (TASC 2025.03)
strategies.source: Ehlers 'Removing Moving Average Lag', TASC 2025.03 (Wealth-Lab rule)
strategies.rules: Ehlers 'Removing Moving Average Lag' (TASC 2025.03; Wealth-Lab rule): enter when the projected moving average (PMA 20) turns up, exit when it turns down; mirror for shorts (ours). Stop 2 ATR, no fixed target.

strategies.name: Ehlers PMA predict line crosses the PMA, cross-back exit, 2 ATR (TASC 2025.03)
strategies.source: Ehlers 'Removing Moving Average Lag', TASC 2025.03 (Python signal)
strategies.rules: Ehlers 'Removing Moving Average Lag' (TASC 2025.03; the Python listing's signal): long while Predict > PMA - ours: enter on the cross over, out on the cross under; mirror. Stop 2 ATR.

strategies.name: Ehlers Trendflex zero cross confirmed by Reflex, out through zero, 2 ATR (TASC 2020.02)
strategies.rules: Ehlers Reflex / Trendflex (TASC 2020.02, 'Reflex: A New Zero-Lag Indicator'): Trendflex crosses zero (trend) while Reflex (cycle) is on the same side; out when Trendflex crosses back. Ehlers gives the zero crossings as the signals; the confirmation, 2 ATR stop and exit are ours.

strategies.name: Zarattini ORB: first 5-min candle's direction, break of it, stop 10% of daily ATR, flat 16:00, RVOL >= 1
strategies.source: Zarattini, Barbon & Aziz 2024, 'A Profitable Day Trading Strategy for the U.S. Equity Market' (QuantConnect)
strategies.rules: Zarattini, Barbon & Aziz, 'A Profitable Day Trading Strategy for the U.S. Equity Market' (SSRN / Swiss Finance Institute 2024; QuantConnect 'Opening Range Breakout for Stocks in Play'): the first 5-minute candle from 09:30 NY sets the direction (bullish -> only longs, bearish -> only shorts); entry when price breaks its high (low) - ours on the close through it, next open; stop 10% of the 14-day ATR (ours: the 14-day average range, agents/indicators adr) from the entry; no target, flat at 16:00 NY. 'Stocks in play' = relative volume of that first candle >= 1 (ours: the bar's volume vs the same

strategies.name: Zarattini ORB with first-candle RVOL >= 2 (stocks in play), stop 10% of daily ATR, flat 16:00
strategies.rules: SC441 with a strict 'in play' filter: first-candle relative volume >= 2 (the paper ranks by RVOL; the top-20 names typically exceed 2x).

strategies.name: ICT macro FVG: gap formed inside a macro window, return entry, gap stop, 2R
strategies.rules: ICT macros (LuxAlgo 'ICT Macros', TradingFinder 'ICT Macro Times'): the algorithm's 20-30 minute delivery windows (02:33-03:00, 04:03-04:30, 08:50-09:10, 09:50-10:10, 10:50-11:10, 11:50-12:10, 13:10-13:40, 15:15-15:45 NY). Only a fair value gap whose third candle closes inside a macro is traded: return into the gap and close back out of it, stop 0.1 ATR beyond the gap, 2R (the library's FVG entry, TV10 / SC250). Best on 1-5 minute bars.

strategies.name: Fractal Chaos Bands breakout with the EMA50 slope, band / 2 ATR stop, 2R
strategies.rules: Fractal Chaos Bands (Edward Dobson): the last confirmed fractal high / low as bands; a close over the upper band with the EMA50 rising = trend breakout (mirror). Stop at the lower band when it is 0.5-3 ATR away, else 2 ATR; target 2R. Differs from SC002 (no Alligator, fractal bands only).

strategies.name: Kairi 25 beyond 2.5 sd of itself and back, target the SMA25, 1.5 ATR stop
strategies.rules: Kairi Relative Index 25 (Japanese classic; Investopedia 'Kairi'): an extreme deviation from the SMA25 reverts. Ours (the classic fixed % thresholds depend on the market): Kairi under -2.5 x its 200-bar standard deviation, then a close back over that line = buy, target the SMA25, stop 1.5 ATR; mirror.

strategies.name: Order block touched twice -> breakaway gap + iFVG away -> trade the gap's return, OB stop, 2R (TikTok idea)
strategies.source: ICT & SMC CHARTIST (TikTok) - explorer idea TT-s-gap-ictchartist
strategies.rules: Explorer idea TT-s-gap-ictchartist (ICT & SMC CHARTIST, TikTok): a higher-timeframe order block touched twice, then a breakaway gap away from it plus an inverted FVG -> sell the bearish FVG (buy the bullish mirror), stop over the high, target the old low. Ours: the block = the latest live order block from swings k 5 (agents/indicators smc; run the strategy on the higher chart for the 'HTF' block), two separate touches (bars entering the block after leaving it), then a breakaway gap (candle 3 closes beyond candle 2, agents/indicators gap_type) in the direction away from the block with an iFVG i

strategies.name: Valid order block (sweep + FVG + BMS), entry at the near wick, far-wick stop, 2R (TikTok idea)
strategies.source: ICT & SMC CHARTIST (TikTok) - explorer idea TT-s-obvalid-ictchartist
strategies.rules: Explorer idea TT-s-obvalid-ictchartist (ICT & SMC CHARTIST, TikTok): an order block counts only if (1) it swept the previous swing high, (2) the move away left an FVG, (3) price closed below the last low (BMS) - mirror for bullish (agents/indicators valid_ob, swings k 3). Entry at the block's near wick (first touch), on a close back away from it; stop 0.1 ATR beyond the block's far wick; target 2R (not in the caption). One trade per block.

strategies.name: Valid order block (sweep + FVG + BMS), entry at the OB open, 2R (TikTok idea)
strategies.source: ICT & SMC CHARTIST (TikTok) - explorer idea TT-s-obvalid-ictchartist
strategies.rules: TT-s-obvalid-ictchartist, entry at the order-block candle's open (the 'body' entry); as SC447 otherwise.

strategies.name: Valid order block (sweep + FVG + BMS), entry at the 50%, 2R (TikTok idea)
strategies.source: ICT & SMC CHARTIST (TikTok) - explorer idea TT-s-obvalid-ictchartist
strategies.rules: TT-s-obvalid-ictchartist, entry at the block's 50% (mean threshold); as SC447 otherwise.

strategies.name: FVG return only when candle 3 closes inside candle 2 (a true FVG, not breakaway), 2R (TikTok idea)
strategies.rules: Explorer idea TT-s-fvg-vs-breakaway (Adem OnChain, TikTok; TradingView 'FVG Breakaway/3rd Candle (Arjo)'): when candle 3 closes INSIDE candle 2's range the gap is a fair value gap and a retest comes first - only those gaps are traded on the return (close back out of the gap, stop 0.1 ATR beyond it, 2R, library FVG entry).

strategies.name: Breakaway gap (candle 3 closes past candle 2): enter at once, stop past candle 1, 2R (TikTok idea)
strategies.source: Adem OnChain (TikTok) - explorer idea TT-s-fvg-vs-breakaway; FVG Breakaway/3rd Candle (Arjo)
strategies.rules: Explorer idea TT-s-fvg-vs-breakaway: when candle 3 closes BEYOND candle 2's extreme it is a breakaway gap - a strong move without a retest, so do not wait: enter on the next open in the gap's direction, stop 0.1 ATR beyond candle 1 (the gap's far side), target 2R (ours).

strategies.name: Sweep reversal only of a significant swing (grade >= 2 of 5), sweep-bar stop, 2R (TikTok idea)
strategies.rules: Explorer idea TT-s-swing-significance (itsnathanoreilly, TikTok: 'not every swing high is equally important for a liquidity sweep'): sweep-and-close-back reversal only when the swept swing grades >= 2 (agents/indicators swing_grade: +1 30-bar extreme, +1 equal highs, +1 prior-day level, +1 age 50+ bars); stop 0.1 ATR beyond the sweep bar, 2R.

strategies.name: Sweep reversal only of a significant swing (grade >= 3 of 5), sweep-bar stop, 2R (TikTok idea)
strategies.rules: TT-s-swing-significance with the stricter threshold: grade >= 3.

strategies.name: TTrades 4H Power of Three: 4H open run takes the prior 4H extreme, close back over the open, flat at 4H end
strategies.source: TTrades 'Trading the 4 Hour Power Of Three - OHLC' - explorer idea TT-s-po3-4h-ttrades
strategies.rules: Explorer idea TT-s-po3-4h-ttrades (TTrades, 'Trading the 4 Hour Power Of Three - OHLC'): every New-York-aligned 4H candle = accumulation at its open, manipulation beyond the open that takes the previous 4H candle's low (high), distribution the other way. Entry on the lower chart: after the run under the 4H open has taken the previous 4H low, a close back over the 4H open = buy; stop 0.1 ATR under the manipulation low, target the previous 4H high when it is >= 1R away (else 2R - ours), flat on the 4H candle's last bar; one trade per 4H candle. Mirror. Differs from SC307 (daily PO3 on the NY mid

strategies.name: Ehlers Synthetic Oscillator: Hann(4) ROC crosses zero, out on the opposite cross, 2 ATR (TASC 2026.04)
strategies.source: Ehlers 'A Synthetic Oscillator', TASC 2026.04 Traders' Tips
strategies.rules: Ehlers 'A Synthetic Oscillator' (TASC 2026.04, RealTest / Wealth-Lab rule in the Traders' Tips): ROC2 = 1-bar change of Hann(Synth, 4); long when ROC2 crosses over 0, out (and short, RealTest's mirror) when it crosses under. The article has no stop - ours 2 ATR, no fixed target.

strategies.name: Ehlers Ultimate Channel breakout with the basis slope, basis stop, 2R (TASC 2024.05)
strategies.source: Ehlers 'Ultimate Channels and Ultimate Bands', TASC 2024.05 (PineCodersTASC open source)
strategies.rules: Ehlers Ultimate Channel (TASC 2024.05): a close over the upper channel (UltimateSmoother 20 + 1 x smoothed true range) with a rising basis = breakout, stop at the basis (or 1 ATR if nearer than 0.5 ATR), 2R; mirror. The article gives no rules - Keltner-style breakout use is ours (it replaces Keltner's EMA / ATR).

strategies.name: Ehlers Ultimate Bands (2 x RMS dev) close back inside, target the basis, 3-bar stop (TASC 2024.05)
strategies.source: Ehlers 'Ultimate Channels and Ultimate Bands', TASC 2024.05
strategies.rules: Ehlers Ultimate Bands (TASC 2024.05): a close back inside the bands after a close outside (Bollinger-style reversion with the low-lag UltimateSmoother basis), target the basis, stop 0.1 ATR beyond the extreme of the last 3 bars. Rules ours (the article gives none).

strategies.name: Kacher-Morales buyable gap-up (>= 0.75 ATR40, 1.5x volume), next session open, gap-day-low stop, 2R
strategies.source: Kacher & Morales buyable gap-up (Trade Like an O'Neil Disciple; chartmill ATR-based BGU)
strategies.rules: Buyable Gap-Up (Kacher & Morales, 'Trade Like an O'Neil Disciple', 2010): the session opens at least 0.75 x the 40-session ATR over the previous session's close (chartmill 'Buyable Gap Ups (ATR based)') on volume >= 1.5 x the 50-session average; buy (Kacher: on the gap day; ours: the next session's 09:30 open, once the gap day's volume is known), stop at the gap day's intraday low (their rule), target 2R (ours - they hold while it acts well). Sessions = New York cash hours 09:30-16:00; feeds without volume pass the volume test. Mirror (a sellable gap-down) for shorts - ours. Differs from GP01

strategies.name: Morning / evening star or abandoned baby after a move (TA-Lib, Bulkowski), pattern stop, 2R
strategies.source: TA-Lib CDLMORNINGSTAR / CDLEVENINGSTAR / CDLABANDONEDBABY + Bulkowski candle statistics
strategies.rules: Morning star / evening star (TA-Lib CDLMORNINGSTAR / CDLEVENINGSTAR, penetration 0.3) or abandoned baby (CDLABANDONEDBABY, shadow gaps) after a move down (up): the close 3 bars ago under (over) its EMA20. Bulkowski ranks the evening star / abandoned babies among the most reliable reversals (https://www.thepatternsite.com/CandlePerformers.html). Stop 0.1 ATR beyond the 3-bar pattern, target 2R (the library standard - the books give no stop). No-gap feeds: the star only needs a body at / beyond the first close.

strategies.name: Three outside up / down after a move (TA-Lib CDL3OUTSIDE), pattern stop, 2R
strategies.rules: Three outside up / down (TA-Lib CDL3OUTSIDE: an engulfing candle and a third candle closing beyond it) after a move down (up), stop 0.1 ATR beyond the pattern, target 2R (ours). Bulkowski: three outside down / up are among his top-performing reversal candles. Differs from the plain engulfing strategies (needs the 3rd-candle confirmation).

strategies.name: Three inside up / down after a move (TA-Lib CDL3INSIDE), pattern stop, 2R
strategies.rules: Three inside up / down (TA-Lib CDL3INSIDE: a long candle, a small opposite harami inside its body, a third candle closing beyond the first candle's open) after a move down (up); stop beyond the pattern, 2R (ours).

strategies.name: Piercing line / dark cloud cover after a move (TA-Lib), pattern stop, 2R
strategies.rules: Piercing line / dark cloud cover (TA-Lib CDLPIERCING / CDLDARKCLOUDCOVER: a long candle, then a long opposite one opening at / beyond its close and closing past the middle of its body but not past its open) after a move down (up); stop beyond the 2 bars, target 2R (ours).

strategies.name: Three-line strike traded the Bulkowski way (with the striking 4th candle), 2R
strategies.source: Bulkowski three-line strike statistics (the bullish strike breaks down)
strategies.rules: Three-line strike traded as Bulkowski measured it (https://www.thepatternsite.com/ThreeLineStrikeBull.html): three rising white candles 'struck' by a black candle that opens at / over the 3rd close and closes under the 1st open - the 'bullish' strike breaks DOWN most of the time, so we sell with the 4th candle (and buy the bearish strike's white 4th candle). Stop 0.1 ATR beyond the 4th candle's extreme, target 2R (ours).

strategies.name: Tweezer bottom / top at the 20-bar extreme + confirmation close within 3 bars, 2R
strategies.source: Tweezer bottom / top at the extreme (Bulkowski, TA-Lib-style equal lows)
strategies.rules: Tweezer bottom / top (equal lows / highs within 5% of the 10-bar average range, a black then a white candle) that is the 20-bar low (high), confirmed by the next close over the tweezer's high (under its low) within 3 bars; stop 0.1 ATR beyond the tweezer, target 2R (ours; Bulkowski: tweezers need the extreme location to work).

strategies.name: RSI 14 hidden divergence with the EMA50 trend (continuation), pivot stop, 2R
strategies.source: RSI hidden divergence continuation (therighttrader; LonesomeTheBlue divergence logic)
strategies.rules: RSI(14) HIDDEN bullish divergence (price higher low, RSI lower low at confirmed 5-bar pivots) with a rising EMA50 under the close -> buy on the confirmation bar (trend continuation; therighttrader 'RSI hidden bullish divergence'); bearish mirror. Stop 0.1 ATR beyond the pivot, target 2R (ours). New vs SC181 / SC195 (regular divergence).

strategies.name: MACD histogram regular divergence at a confirmed 5-bar pivot, pivot stop, 2R
strategies.source: MACD histogram regular divergence (LonesomeTheBlue 'Divergence for Many Indicators v4')
strategies.rules: MACD histogram (12/26/9) REGULAR divergence at confirmed 5-bar pivots (price lower low, histogram higher low) -> buy on the confirmation bar (5 bars after the pivot); bearish mirror. Stop 0.1 ATR beyond the pivot, target 2R (ours).

strategies.name: Divergence for Many: 3+ of 7 oscillators diverge at a pivot (LonesomeTheBlue), pivot stop, 2R
strategies.source: LonesomeTheBlue 'Divergence for Many Indicators v4' (TradingView open source)
strategies.rules: Divergence for Many Indicators (LonesomeTheBlue v4): at a confirmed 5-bar pivot at least 3 of the 7 oscillators (RSI, MACD hist, CCI, momentum, OBV, MFI, Stochastic) show a regular divergence -> trade the reversal on the confirmation bar; stop 0.1 ATR beyond the pivot, target 2R (ours).

strategies.name: Ehlers Reversion Index: SS4 trigger crosses SS8 on the far side of zero, out on the opposite cross (TASC 2026.01)
strategies.source: Ehlers 'The Reversion Index', TASC 2026.01 (Traders' Tips, Wealth-Lab / Python rules)
strategies.rules: Ehlers 'The Reversion Index' (TASC 2026.01): the SuperSmoother-4 trigger crosses over the SuperSmoother-8 line while the index is under zero -> buy (Wealth-Lab / Python listings: buy the trigger's cross over, sell the cross under; the under-zero / over-zero condition is ours - the article calls it a mean-reversion tool); out on the opposite cross. Stop 2 ATR, no target.

strategies.name: Ehlers Adaptive SuperSmoother crosses the fixed SuperSmoother 20, stop and reverse-out, 2 ATR (TASC 2026.09)
strategies.rules: Ehlers Adaptive SuperSmoother (TASC 2026.09): the adaptive filter crosses over the fixed SuperSmoother(20) -> buy, under -> sell ('preferred direction long while the adaptive filter is above'); out on the opposite cross; stop 2 ATR, no target (ours).

strategies.name: Ehlers AutoTune band-pass zero cross, opposite-cross exit, 1.5 ATR, 2R (TASC 2026.05)
strategies.rules: Ehlers AutoTune Filter (TASC 2026.05): the band-pass tuned to the dominant cycle crosses zero upward -> buy, downward -> sell (zero crossings are the cited signals); out on the opposite crossing; stop 1.5 ATR, target 2R (ours).

strategies.name: DeMark TD REI back inside +/-40 after 1-6 bars beyond (duration rule), 5-bar stop, 2R
strategies.source: DeMark TD REI with the duration rule (Linn Software / fxcodebase)
strategies.rules: DeMark TD REI (5) with his duration rule: REI was under -40 for 1-6 bars in a row (not longer - a longer stay is a trend) and closes back over -40 -> buy; mirror over +40. Stop 0.1 ATR beyond the 5-bar extreme, target 2R (ours; DeMark pairs it with TD POQ - not modelled).

strategies.name: TD Pressure back over 35 (under 65) with the EMA50 trend, 1.5 ATR, 2R
strategies.source: DeMark TD Pressure (our reconstruction) as a trend pullback
strategies.rules: TD Pressure (5, our build) as a trend pullback: with a rising EMA50 under the close, pressure dips under 35 (supply) and crosses back over 35 -> buy; mirror (over 65 and back under, falling EMA50). Stop 1.5 ATR, target 2R (ours; the 35 / 65 pullback levels are ours - 25 / 75 mark the rare extremes).

strategies.name: Naked POC first-touch fade (close back on the approach side), 0.25 ATR beyond the bar, 2R
strategies.source: LuxAlgo 'Naked POC As Level' - fade the first touch
strategies.rules: Naked POC first touch (LuxAlgo 'Naked POC As Level': 'fade into a first touch'): a bar touches an untouched previous-session POC coming from above and closes back over it -> buy (from below and closes under it -> sell). Stop 0.25 ATR beyond the bar's extreme, target 2R (ours - the source gives no numbers).

strategies.name: Value-area breakout toward a naked POC 1-6 ATR away, target the naked POC, 1 ATR stop
strategies.source: Naked POC as a magnet target (LuxAlgo / NexusFi naked VPOC)
strategies.rules: Naked POC as a magnet: the close crosses over the previous session's value-area high with a naked POC 1-6 ATR over it -> buy, target that naked POC; mirror under the value-area low toward a naked POC under. Stop 1 ATR (ours).

strategies.name: Rotation over the session open toward an unrepaired poor high (poor low) 0.5-5 ATR away, target its repair, 1 ATR stop
strategies.source: LuxAlgo 'Poor High / Poor Low' - unfinished business revisit
strategies.rules: Poor high / poor low revisit (LuxAlgo 'Poor High / Poor Low': unfinished business, a candidate draw when price rotates back): the close crosses over the session open with an unrepaired poor high 0.5-5 ATR over it -> buy, target the poor high + 0.1 ATR (its repair); mirror toward a poor low. Stop 1 ATR (ours).

strategies.name: Single-print zone fill: entering a previous session's single prints, target the far edge
strategies.source: Market Profile single prints fill (LuxAlgo 'Single Prints')
strategies.rules: Single prints fill (Market Profile: low-acceptance zones of one TPO period tend to be crossed quickly once re-entered): a bar enters a previous session's single-print zone from below -> buy, target the zone's far edge; from above -> sell. Stop 0.3 ATR beyond the bar's extreme (ours).

strategies.name: Taylor buy day / sell short day: after 1-3 down (up) days, reclaim of the previous day's low (high), target its high
strategies.source: George Taylor, 'The Taylor Trading Technique' - buy day / sell short day (StoneX summary)
strategies.rules: Taylor Trading Technique buy day / sell short day (StoneX summary): after 1-3 lower daily closes the market trades under the previous day's low and a close comes back over it -> buy (trapping the last sellers), target the previous day's high (the sell-day rally target; 2R if that is under 1R away); mirror after 1-3 higher closes over the previous high. First signal per day; stop 0.1 ATR beyond today's extreme (ours).

strategies.name: Taylor inside day go-with: close beyond the last inside day's high / low (2 days), mid-range stop, 2R
strategies.source: Taylor Trading Technique - inside day go-with trade (StoneX summary)
strategies.rules: Taylor inside day 'go with' trade (StoneX summary: on an inside day both its high and low are the references): the last inside day (yesterday or the day before - ours, so the levels live 2 days) -> the first close over its high buys, under its low sells, once per day; stop at the middle of the inside day's range, target 2R (ours).

strategies.name: Zarattini noise-area intraday momentum (SPY paper): :00 / :30 breaks of the noise area, VWAP trail, out 16:00 NY
strategies.source: Zarattini, Aziz, Barbon 'Beat the Market: An Effective Intraday Momentum Strategy for SPY' (2024)
strategies.rules: 'Beat the Market' intraday momentum (Zarattini, Aziz, Barbon 2024, SPY): at each :00 / :30 New York decision time from 10:00, a close over the noise area's upper bound (open x (1 + 14-day mean |move from the open| at that time), gap-adjusted with the previous close) buys, under the lower bound sells; the stop trails at max(UB, VWAP) for longs (min(LB, VWAP) for shorts), checked at the decision times; everything out at the 16:00 close. Ours: the initial hard stop = the trailing level (or 0.25 ATR under the entry close if that is over it); no target; the paper's volatility sizing is left to the bot.

strategies.name: IPF pivot-stop breakout of an area-extreme pivot 1+ ATR away, fake-breakout exit, 1.5 ATR, 2R, BE (MQL5 EA)
strategies.source: IPF Price Action EA - pivot stop orders with a fake-breakout exit (MQL5 blog)
strategies.rules: IPF Price Action EA (MQL5 blog https://www.mql5.com/en/blogs/post/777967; H4 / D1, no indicators): a confirmed pivot high (5 bars each side) that is the extreme of its area (the 30-bar high) and at least 1 ATR from the close when it is confirmed; a close over it buys (their buy-stop), mirror under a pivot low. The post's 'fake-breakout exit': out if the bar after the entry closes back under the level (ours: on the entry chart, not M1). Stop 1.5 ATR, target 2R, break-even at half way (ours - the post gives no numbers).

strategies.name: Trend Surfer DAX: RSI14 SMA4 vs SMA29 (35 / 40), 09-11 + 15-17 Frankfurt, out 11:00 / 17:00, 12 ATR / 2.5 ATR (ProRealCode)
strategies.rules: ProRealCode 'Trend Surfer DAX' (https://www.prorealcode.com/prorealtime-trading-strategies/trend-surfer-dax/ ; DAX 5-minute): RSI 14, priceline = SMA4(RSI), middle band = SMA29(RSI). Entries only 09:00-11:00 and 15:00-17:00 Frankfurt. Long: priceline over the middle band, priceline > 35 and middle band > 40 (first bar of that state); short: priceline crosses under the middle band with priceline > 40. Out at 11:00 / 17:00. Source stop 250 points and target 50 points translated for DAX 5m (ATR14 ~ 20 points): stop 12 ATR, target 2.5 ATR.

strategies.name: VTAD Turnaround Tuesday DAX: Monday 17:45 buy under the daily SMA34, out Wednesday 09:00, 2.6% / 2.3% (ProRealCode)
strategies.rules: VTAD Turnaround Tuesday - DAX (ProRealCode https://www.prorealcode.com/prorealtime-trading-strategies/vtad-turnaround-tuesday-dax-15m/ ; 15-minute, also 5-minute): on Monday at 17:45 Frankfurt buy if Monday's close is under the daily SMA34 of closes; out on Wednesday 09:00 Frankfurt. Stop 2.6% and target 2.3% (the poster's additions; VTAD has none). Ours: the 17:45 bar's close stands for Monday's close, the SMA34 uses the 33 completed days before + that close. Differs from SE03 (Monday down vs Friday, out Tuesday's close, no SMA filter).

strategies.name: Breaks and retests: 20-bar close extreme break, retest 2-4 bars later closing back, 2% stop, 2R (StockSharp)
strategies.rules: StockSharp 'Breaks and Retests' (https://doc.stocksharp.com/en/api-examples/0563_Breaks_and_Retests ; 5-minute): levels = highest / lowest CLOSE of the prior 20 bars; after a close over the resistance, a retest 2-4 bars later (the bar's low touches the broken level and it closes back over it) buys; mirror for shorts. Stop 2% from the entry (source). Source trail (after 5% profit, 1% under the best close) - ours: target 2R instead, the plan has no trailing.

strategies.name: S/R 55-bar breakout with the EMA500, 3 ATR 1:1, opposite-band exit (StockSharp)
strategies.rules: StockSharp 'Support & Resistance Breakout' (https://doc.stocksharp.com/en/api-examples/3998_Support_Resistance_Breakout ; 1-hour default): resistance / support = the prior 55 bars' high / low; long on a close over the resistance with the close over EMA 500, short mirror; an in-profit close beyond the opposite band exits (ours: the close beyond the 55-bar opposite band). Source stop / target 500 points each - ours 3 ATR / 1R (1:1 like the source). Differs from the turtle 55/20 (TV14): EMA500 filter, 1:1 fixed exits.

strategies.name: Larry Williams swing-range breakout: open +/- 0.5 x max(|H4-L1|, |H2-L4|), range stop, 4R (MQL5 Part 6)
strategies.source: Larry Williams Market Secrets Part 6 - volatility breakouts using market swings (MQL5 article)
strategies.rules: Larry Williams Market Secrets Part 6 (https://www.mql5.com/en/articles/20862 ; daily): range = the larger of |high 4 days ago - low 1 day ago| and |high 2 days ago - low 4 days ago| (swing range); buy when price crosses today's open + 0.5 x range, sell under the open - 0.5 x range (first cross of the day, intraday bars); stop 0.5 x range from the entry level, target 4R. Differs from BK05 (yesterday's range, open stop, day-end exit).

strategies.name: Larry Williams 3 down (up) closes -> open + 0.5 x range break, prior-bar stop, 3R, 3 bars (MQL5 Part 9)
strategies.source: Larry Williams Market Secrets Part 9 - Patterns to Profit (MQL5 article)
strategies.rules: Larry Williams Market Secrets Part 9 'Patterns to Profit' (https://www.mql5.com/en/articles/21063 ; daily): after three down closes in a row buy the move over the open + 0.5 x the previous bar's range (after three up closes sell under the open - 0.5 x range); stop the previous bar's low (high), target 3R, out after 3 bars.

strategies.name: Larry Williams bearish (bullish) outside day -> open + 0.5 x range break, 3R, 3 bars (MQL5 Part 9)
strategies.source: Larry Williams Market Secrets Part 9 - Patterns to Profit (MQL5 article)
strategies.rules: Larry Williams Part 9 (https://www.mql5.com/en/articles/21063): the previous bar a bearish outside bar (higher high, lower low - or, ours, a body that engulfs the previous body - close under its open) -> buy the move over the open + 0.5 x its range; mirror after a bullish outside bar; stop its low (high), target 3R, out after 3 bars.

strategies.name: Larry Williams short-term swing low / high (no outside / inside bars), pivot-bar stop, hold 1 bar (MQL5 Part 4)
strategies.source: Larry Williams Market Secrets Part 4 - short-term swing highs and lows (MQL5 article)
strategies.rules: Larry Williams Part 4 short-term swing points (https://www.mql5.com/en/articles/20716 ; daily, any chart): bar 2's low under the lows of bars 1 and 3 (bar 1 = the bar just closed), skipped when bar 2 is an outside bar of bar 3 or bar 1 is an inside bar of bar 2 -> buy; mirror with highs -> sell. Stop at bar 2's low (high); the source's default exit: hold one bar (out at the next bar).

strategies.name: Ehlers Correlation Trend 20 crosses +/-0.5, out at 0, 2 ATR (TASC 2020.05)
strategies.rules: Ehlers Correlation Trend Indicator (TASC 2020.05, https://www.traders.com/Documentation/FEEDbk_docs/2020/05/TradersTips.html ): CTI 20 crosses over +0.5 (trend begins) buys, under -0.5 sells; out when it falls back under 0 (over 0); stop 2 ATR (ours - the article gives no stop).

strategies.name: TTM Trend flip: 2 bars of the new colour after 6+, EMA50 slope, 1.5 ATR, 2R, 2-bar colour exit (Carter)
strategies.rules: TTM Trend (Carter; our build agents/indicators ttm_trend): the second trend bar of the new colour after 6+ bars of the other colour, with the EMA50 slope agreeing; stop 1.5 ATR, target 2R, out on 2 bars of the other colour (Carter: 'stay in while the bars stay blue').

strategies.name: TTM Scalper reversal square with the EMA50 trend, pivot stop, 2R (Carter)
strategies.rules: TTM Scalper reversal squares (Carter; our build agents/indicators ttm_scalper) taken only with the trend: buy square while the close is over EMA 50, sell square under it; stop 0.2 ATR beyond the pivot bar, target 2R.

strategies.name: Murrey Math 0/8 - 8/8 false break fade, target 4/8, 1/8 stop
strategies.rules: Murrey Math (LuxAlgo https://www.luxalgo.com/library/indicator/murrey-math-levels/ : 0/8 ultimate support, 8/8 ultimate resistance, 4/8 pivot): a bar dips under 0/8 and closes back over it -> buy, target 4/8, stop 1/8 under 0/8; mirror at 8/8. Stop and target placement ours (the source names the roles only).

strategies.name: Murrey Math 4/8 pivot cross after 3 closes on the other side, target 6/8 / 2/8
strategies.rules: Murrey Math 4/8 pivot (LuxAlgo summary: 'closes above / below 4/8'): a close over 4/8 after 3 closes under it buys, target 6/8 (the next reversal rung), stop under 2/8; mirror. Placement ours.

strategies.name: 20-bar breakout only while Chaikin Volatility 10/10 is >= 0 and not falling (ranges expanding), 2 ATR, 2R
strategies.rules: Chaikin Volatility (https://www.incrediblecharts.com/indicators/chaikin_volatility.php : expanding range confirms a breakout, contracting range warns it is weak): a close beyond the prior 20-bar high / low taken only while Chaikin Volatility 10/10 is >= 0 and not falling (ranges expanding); skipped when it is under 0 (ranges contracting); stop 2 ATR, target 2R. Combination ours.

strategies.name: Standard Error Bands squeeze (50-bar low width) then close outside with the slope, mid exit, 2 ATR (Andersen)
strategies.source: Standard Error Bands, Jon Andersen (LuxAlgo library)
strategies.rules: Andersen Standard Error Bands (https://www.luxalgo.com/library/indicator/standard-error-bands/ : tight bands = a strong steady trend / coiling, widening after = the move): band width at its 50-bar low within the last 5 bars, then a close outside the band in the direction of the regression slope; out on a close back at the middle; stop 2 ATR. Differs from SC322 (fade back inside a linreg / standard-error channel).

strategies.name: Projection Oscillator crosses its trigger under 20 / over 80, band stop, other-band target (Widner)
strategies.rules: Widner Projection Oscillator (https://www.prorealcode.com/prorealtime-indicators/projection-oscillator ; LuxAlgo concept https://www.luxalgo.com/library/concept/projection-bands/ ): PO 14 crosses over its EMA5 trigger with both under 20 -> buy, crosses under with both over 80 -> sell; stop 0.25 ATR beyond the projection band, target the other band.

strategies.name: Wave PM energy release: 20-bar break as Wave PM rises through 0.5 after compression, 2 ATR, 2R (Whistler)
strategies.rules: Mark Whistler's Wave PM (https://www.tradingview.com/script/l9Oqp36g-Wave-PM ; Whistler: energy stored while the wave is low, released when it rises): Wave PM was under 0.5 within the last 10 bars and the close breaks the prior 20-bar high (low) while Wave PM rises over 0.5 -> trade the break; stop 2 ATR, target 2R. Combination ours.

strategies.name: Sentiment Zone Oscillator back over the dynamic oversold (under overbought) with the EMA60 trend, zone exit (Khalil)
strategies.rules: Khalil Sentiment Zone Oscillator (TASC 2012.05, https://www.traders.com/Documentation/FEEDbk_docs/2012/05/Khalil.html ): in an uptrend (close over EMA 60) buy when SZO crosses back over the dynamic oversold zone; in a downtrend sell when it crosses back under the overbought zone; out on the opposite zone touch; stop 2 ATR (ours).

strategies.name: Rainbow Oscillator crosses its SMA9 while the rainbow widens, swing stop, opposite-cross exit (Widner)
strategies.rules: Widner Rainbow Oscillator (cTrader https://help.ctrader.com/indicators/built-in/oscillators/rainbow-oscillator/ : buy when RO crosses over its average, sell under; stop beyond the recent swing; out on the opposite cross), only while the Rainbow Bandwidth widens (over its 20-bar mean, Widner: wide rainbow = trend); stop the 5-bar swing +/- 0.1 ATR, opposite-cross exit.

strategies.name: Madrid MA Ribbon turns all lime / all red, out at score 0, 2 ATR
strategies.rules: Madrid MA Ribbon (https://in.tradingview.com/script/WH01CtjA-Madrid-MA-Ribbon-Bar ): the ribbon turns all lime (score 1: all 18 EMAs rising over EMA100) after being under 0.5 within 10 bars -> buy; all red -> sell; out when the score crosses 0; stop 2 ATR (ours).

strategies.name: Andrews' Pitchfork lower (upper) parallel test with a bull (bear) bar, bar stop, median-line target
strategies.source: Andrew's Pitchfork Trading Strategy (Trading Setups Review)
strategies.rules: Andrews' Pitchfork (Trading Setups Review https://www.tradingsetupsreview.com/andrews-pitchfork-trading-strategy/ ): in a bull fork (A a pivot low, rising median) price tests the lower parallel - the bar's low reaches it while its high stays over it - and closes as a bull bar over the line -> buy (source: a tick over that bar's high; ours: the close); stop under the bar's low (0.1 ATR), target the median line. Mirror at the upper parallel of a bear fork.
